recentItems.title: Mahurat of Badhai Ho Badhai 2002 | Subhash Ghai, Anil Kapoor and Satish Kaushik | Mukta Arts Ltd
recentItems.description:
Watch legendary filmmaker Subhash Ghai speak at the muhurat ceremony of Badhaai Ho Badhaai, a 2002 Bollywood family entertainer directed by Satish Kaushik and starring Anil Kapoor, Shilpa Shetty, and Keerthi Reddy. The event marks the traditional launch of the film with prayers and heartfelt speeches.
In this exclusive footage, Subhash Ghai shares his thoughts and blessings for the film

recentItems.description: Experience the magic as Sai Godbole delivers a heartfelt live performance of the title song from Amaira at the grand premiere held at Suncity Mukta A2 Cinema, Vile Parle.

recentItems.title: Cultural Minister Ashish Shelar Speaks at Amaira Marathi Movie Premiere
recentItems.description:
Ashish Shelar announced that the government would provide financial assistance to Marathi producers and directors to help them overcome these hurdles.
These initiatives reflect Minister Shelar's broader vision to foster creativity, preserve the legacy of Marathi cinema, and ensure its growth in the modern era.

recentItems.title: Subhash Ghai’s Words of Thanks and Appreciation
recentItems.description: In this special message, renowned filmmaker Subhash Ghai expresses his heartfelt gratitude to the team behind Amaira, including Ashish Shelar and Mr. Turani, the owner of Tips. His words honor the passion, support, and collaboration that made the journey possible...

recentItems.title: Amaira Grand Premiere at SunCity | Celebrities & Glam Moments!
recentItems.description:
Experience the dazzling Grand Premiere of the Marathi movie Amaira at SunCity, where the stars came out in full force!
The premiere was filled with excitement, elegance, and enthusiasm for this powerful Marathi film. Don’t miss this inside look at one of the most glamorous nights of the year...
